title: Local effectivity of uniformly bounded normalized constructible towers
statement: Let $T$ be a Noetherian scheme and let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with $R_n=(A/I^n)_T$ and $A_T=\varprojlim R_n$ on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Let $M_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(T))$ be supplied with level objects $M_n\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_n))$ identifying their restrictions of scalars with its evaluations. Suppose there are normalization isomorphisms $M_{n+1}\otimes^L_{R_{n+1}}R_n\cong M_n$ whose scalar-extension maps induce its transitions and which satisfy the quotient cocycle. Assume each cohomology sheaf of each $M_n$ is constructible in the intrinsic finite-stratification, finite-lisse sense of [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], and that there are integers $a\leq b$, independent of $n$, with $\mathcal H^q(M_n)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$. Then each $M_n$ has bounded constructible etale origin in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and $M_\bullet$ admits the common finite stratification, pro-etale coverings, bounded adic-lisse finite-type local complexes, and normalization-compatible reduction isomorphisms required by [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]; in particular it is uniformly bounded constructible in that full sense. The local terms are not asserted to be projective. This assertion requires both the normalized derived reductions and the common cohomological interval, not merely levelwise constructibility.

source.place: Tag 09AL (lemma-compare-constructible-derived) gives the finite-level etale-origin conclusion for any Noetherian coefficient ring. Tags 09BU (lemma-Noetherian-constructible), 09BV (lemma-weird), 09BW (lemma-connected-lisse), and 09BX (lemma-Noetherian-adic-constructible), for finite-type adic sheaves, with Tag 09AV (more-algebra-lemma-Rlim-pseudo-coherent-gives-complete-pseudo-coherent) in more-algebra.tex. Agent assembly for uniformly bounded normalized derived systems. Tags 09C3/09C6/09C7 supply the parallel finite-Tor derived argument, but are not claimed to state this non-finite-Tor criterion.

proof.text: Apply the single finite-ring origin presentation theorem separately to each quotient level, installing its recorded finiteness instance. This gives the first conclusion without changing its presentation.
Use the first quotient and the common interval to obtain one finite stratification on which all restricted cohomology sheaves of all levels are relatively finite lisse.

Apply lisse normalized reconstruction to each stratum immersion. Retain its covering sieve and the common realized complex, its bounds, adic lissity, and finite-lisse reduction cohomology. Invert each reconstruction isomorphism to obtain the local-model identifications. For each m >= n, cancel the invertible scalar restriction of e_n and use e_m.inv_hom_id to invert the supplied forward transition square. Pack these fields in AdicTowerLocalModel. Use the common interval a,b and the constructed stratification to give uniformly bounded constructibility.
